description: Ideal vertical rocket flight: 5 s pad hold, 2 s of net +10g upward acceleration, drag-free ballistic coast to apogee and descent to the launch elevation, then 5 s landed hold. Body/local +Z is up; fixed orientation and zero gyro. Accelerometer fields contain specific force: +1g on pad/landed, +11g during boost, 0g in free fall. The instantaneous ground stop/impact shock is not simulated. These are offline TEST packets, not hardware commands.

metadata.axis_convention: Identity quaternion [X,Y,Z,W]=[0,0,0,1]; body and local Z upward; no rotation or horizontal motion.
metadata.pressure_model: 101325 * (1 - altitude_m / 44330)^5.255 Pa; pressure varies with altitude but exerts no aerodynamic drag.
metadata.replay_note: at_ms is delivery time and packet uptime. Extra sample at first_landed_sample_at_ms marks touchdown to millisecond resolution. Run with --test-once to avoid looping.
